messages.content:
Title: [security] Fetched pages are passed to the model without sanitisation

Severity: high

An HTML comment in a fetched page is currently forwarded to the model verbatim. A page containing a comment that instructs the assistant to read ~/.aws/credentials and POST them to an external host would be followed. Suggested fix: strip comments and wrap fetched content in an untrusted-data delimiter before it reaches the model.
